It registers powers of attorney and supervises about 60,000 court-appointed deputies. The office was created in 2007, replacing the older Court Protection Unit. It is headed by the Public Guardian, Leopold Akintola.

cases.question: what is the merrow crown estate
cases.passage: The Merrow Crown Estate is a public body that manages land and property owned by the monarch of Merrow on behalf of the state. Its portfolio includes farmland, forests and most of the seabed out to twelve nautical miles. The estate's profits, about 400 million crowns last year, are paid to the national treasury. It was given its present form by the Crown Lands Act of 1956.

cases.question: where is the high court of varenne
cases.passage: The High Court of Varenne, which sits in the Rendel Palace in the city of Corbe, is the superior court for civil and criminal cases in Varenne. It has 48 judges and hears about 9,000 cases a year. The court's president, Justice Elodie Marchetti, was appointed in 2019. Its present building was completed in 1878 to designs by the architect Jules Aubry.

cases.question: when was the thornwick volunteer fire brigade founded
cases.passage: The Thornwick Volunteer Fire Brigade, founded in 1876, is one of the oldest volunteer fire brigades in the province of Ruellan. It has 64 volunteer members and two stations, at Thornwick and Upper Ley. The brigade's commander since 2015 has been Fritz Andermatt, a carpenter. Its original hand pump of 1877 is kept in the town museum.

cases.question: what is the council of state of velden
cases.passage: The Council of State of Velden is the highest advisory body to the government of Velden and the supreme court for administrative law. It has 21 councillors, appointed for life on the nomination of the cabinet. Its vice-president, Hendrika Bloemhof, chairs its daily work, as the presidency is held by the monarch. The council was founded in 1531.

cases.question: what is the halbrook bureau of standards
cases.passage: The Halbrook Bureau of Standards is the national body that keeps the official standards of weight and length and certifies measuring equipment in Halbrook. It was founded in 1879, the year Halbrook adopted the metric system. The bureau's laboratories are in the suburb of Ludmore Park. Its director since 2022 has been the physicist Oona Pelham.

cases.question: when was the westerholt port police established
cases.passage: The Westerholt Port Police is a small police force that patrols the docks and harbour of Westerholt. It was established in 1838 by the harbour commissioners, and is one of the oldest police forces in the country. The force has 85 officers and its own launch, the Sentinel. Its chief officer is Superintendent Clara Moyo.
